inputs.coverage: A triaxial ellipsoid fitted to Voyager images by Karkoschka (2003), with semi-axes of 90 × 74 × 64 km. The images constrain the outline rather than a reliable map of craters or terrain. The standard gray grid marks unavailable surface coverage; shared lighting describes the model shape. The 74 km radius sets the scene scale and is not a replacement for the three measured axes.
